title: PGxRAG: A Retrieval Augmented Generation supported Pharmacogenomics Assistant

model.params_source: paper Table 2 (Temperature 0 for the llm approach); max_tokens assumed; snapshot by the date rule (record)

task.approximation: LLM-only condition, no retrieval; free-text answers mapped to an option letter by a fixed parser instead of SME checking

items.source: Wellytics/PGxRAG, file 'PGxRAG Supplementary tables_revised.xlsx' (Supplementary Table 1: questions with ground truth)
items.license: unknown (no license on the HF page)
items.layout_verified: sheet 'Supplementary table 1': row 1 title, row 2 header (Question_with_Ground_Truth, References), rows 3-227 = 225 questions; each Question_with_Ground_Truth cell is a JSON string {Question, Options {A, B, C, D}, 'Correct option': 'A. <text>', Explanation}
items.source_type_prose: hf (xlsx parsed by the hook with pandas/openpyxl)

prompt.source_location: Table 1, column 'Query' (question JSON as sent to the model); no system prompt reported
prompt.verbatim: full (the JSON query object of Table 1 with its two slots)

placeholders_prose.question: items.Question
placeholders_prose._note: hook render: json.dumps({Question, Options{A..D}}, indent=0) = the Table 1 query object with escaped values

output.parse: hook: JSON 'Correct option'/'Answer' letter | LAST explicit answer statement ('the correct/best answer|option is: **"X"', 'Option X ... is the recommended') | first quoted or bold letter with a colon ('"C": ...', '**A**:') | a single named 'Option X' | a single line-start 'X.'/'X)' (uppercase A-D only)
output.postprocess: strip code fences; compare the letter with the ground-truth letter; unparsable counts as incorrect
output.parse_prose: json field 'Correct option' -> leading letter A-D; fallback regex \b([A-D])[\.\)]

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: number of responses whose selected option matches the SME-verified correct option, divided by 225, in percent
metric.original_location: Table 2, row gpt-4-turbo / Temperature 0 / Approach llm (182 of 225 correct)

open_points: [triage 2026-09-09 g1] 22 of 675 replies name no option letter (free-text explanation, or two hedged options) and count as incorrect - the paper's SMEs mapped such answers by hand; 5 replies enumerate several quoted letters without an explicit choice statement and the first quoted letter is taken (ids 49, 119, 209): at most +/-1 pp.
notes: The model's Table 1 response format (Correct option / Explanation / References) is not requested in the prompt; the parser handles both JSON and prose replies. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] xlsx loader + JSON-cell parsing in the hook; 225 rows verified; prepare verified. || [triage 2026-09-09 g1] DEFECT (parse). The archived gpt-4-turbo replies state the choice as 'The correct answer is "C": "<option text>"' or open with '"B": "<option text>"' (566 of 675; the quoted keys of the JSON query) or in prose ('the best option from the provided choices is: **B**', '**Option B**: ...'); the old regexes covered only JSON / 'correct answer is X' / 'X.' and, with re.I on the letter class, matched the article 'a' as option A (581 unparsed, 8.1%). New parser: 8.15 -> 78.81 (per seed 78.2/79.6/78.7), 22 unparsed, original 80.889 inside the 95% CI of every seed. Rule usage over 675 replies: explicit statement 417 (330 correct), quoted/bold letter 189 (166), JSON 12 (12), single 'Option X' or line-start letter 35 (24), none 22. The replies deviate in FORMAT from the paper's Table 1 JSON response (prose, explanation appended) but not in the option chosen. Before/after: result_before_triage.json / result.json.
runner_gaps: parse: json field names with spaces
hook: harness/tierb/hooks/W4414494504.py: load_items (xlsx sheet 'Supplementary table 1', JSON cells -> question/options/answer_letter), render (JSON query object), parse (letter)
